Each time you or your opponent spend one or more Command points to use a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if your plan is in Ascendance: on a 1-2, your opponent gains 1CP; on a 6+, you gain 1CP.

rule.name: Fervent Devotees
rule.text: Melee weapons equipped by THOUSAND SONS models from your army have the [SUSTAiNED HiTS 1] ability while targeting an enemy unit within range of an objective marker.

Psychic Ingress.name: PSYCHIC INGRESS
Psychic Ingress.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER CHARACTER model from your army.
Psychic Ingress.effect: Open every Hatchway within 3" of your model. When measuring this distance, ignore Walls and closed Hatchways.
Psychic Ingress.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.
Psychic Ingress.text:
WHEN: End of any phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER CHARACTER model from your army.

EFFECT: Open every Hatchway within 3" of your model. When measuring this distance, ignore Walls and closed Hatchways.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
Psychic Ingress.flavour: The Sorcerers of the Thousand Sons can draw upon their powers to melt away hatches and bulkheads.

Flesh Change.name: FLESH CHANGE
Flesh Change.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Flesh Change.target: One TZAANGORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Flesh Change.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
Flesh Change.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TZAANGORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
Flesh Change.flavour: Tzeentch’s mutagenic gifts lend resilience to those brave or fool hardy enough to embrace them.

Fell Sacrifice.name: FELL SACRIFICE
Fell Sacrifice.when: Your opponent’s Command phase, at the start of the Battle-shock step.
Fell Sacrifice.target: One THOUSAND SONS CHARACTER or TZAANGORS unit from your army.
Fell Sacrifice.effect: Select one enemy unit below its Starting Strength that is within Engagement Range of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that enemy unit is also Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. This Enhancement cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
Fell Sacrifice.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Command phase, at the start of the Battle-shock step.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS CHARACTER or TZAANGORS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit below its Starting Strength that is within Engagement Range of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that enemy unit is also Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. This Enhancement cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
Fell Sacrifice.flavour: As ritual violence gathers in intensity, the massed thralls of the Thousand Sons swell with the terrifying powers of the warp.

Bestial Surge.name: BESTIAL SURGE
Bestial Surge.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Bestial Surge.target: One TZAANGORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Bestial Surge.effect: Your unit can make a Bestial Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.
Bestial Surge.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One TZAANGORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Bestial Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.
Bestial Surge.flavour: When struck by enemy fire, the bestial Tzaangors react with instinctive fury, surging towards their assailants in a vengeful flock.

enhancements.name: Thrallmaster
enhancements.text: At the start of the first battle round, you can select one friendly THOUSAND SONS CULTISTS or TZAANGORS unit within the same Entry Zone as the bearer. If you do, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Prescient Authority
enhancements.text: Once per turn, when a friendly THOUSAND SONS CULTISTS or TZAANGORS unit within 3" of the bearer is selected to shoot or fight, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that THOUSAND SONS CULTISTS or TZAANGORS unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

rule.name: Twisting Fate
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Cabal of Sorcerers ability lose it and THOUSAND SONS units from your army gain this one.

While a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army is on the battlefield and you control at least as many objective markers as your opponent does, your plan is considered to be in Ascendance. Each time you or your opponent spend one or more Command points to use a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if your plan is in Ascendance: on a 1-2, your opponent gains 1CP; on a 6+, you gain 1CP.

rule.name: Methodical Conquest
rule.text: Each time a THOUSAND SONS model from your army makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6. In addition, SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS units from your army can perform the Set Overwatch Tactical Manoeuvre in the same turn as performing the Secure Site Tactical Manoeuvre.

Enduring Animus.name: ENDURING ANIMUS
Enduring Animus.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Enduring Animus.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Enduring Animus.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Enduring Animus.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Enduring Animus.flavour: The malefic spirit echoes bound within the armour of the Thousand Sons cling tenaciously to existence and are not banished easily.

Strategic Vision.name: STRATEGIC VISION
Strategic Vision.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Strategic Vision.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability, and models in your unit can target enemy units that are not within Engagement Range of them (as long as they are otherwise eligible targets).
Strategic Vision.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability, and models in your unit can target enemy units that are not within Engagement Range of them (as long as they are otherwise eligible targets).
Strategic Vision.flavour: Flickering visions allow this Sorcerer to foresee enemy threats and direct the weapons of their thralls accordingly.

Phantasmic Munitions.name: PHANTASMIC MUNITIONS
Phantasmic Munitions.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Phantasmic Munitions.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can ignore enemy models for the purposes of determining visibility.
Phantasmic Munitions.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can ignore enemy models for the purposes of determining visibility.
Phantasmic Munitions.flavour: The Sorcerer renders the shells and blasts of their warriors ethereal, allowing them to pass through intervening targets before solidifying again to lethal effect.

Invisible Assailants.name: INVISIBLE ASSAILANTS
Invisible Assailants.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
Invisible Assailants.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army.
Invisible Assailants.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your model. That unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, until the start of your opponent’s next Movement phase, subtract 2" from the Move characteristic of models in that unit and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it; if passed, subtract 1" from the Move characteristic of models in that unit and subtract 1 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.
Invisible Assailants.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit visible to your model. That unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, until the start of your opponent’s next Movement phase, subtract 2" from the Move characteristic of models in that unit and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it; if passed, subtract 1" from the Move characteristic of models in that unit and subtract 1 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.
Invisible Assailants.flavour: Flocking to the Sorcerer's summons, swarms of minor warp entities assail the enemy, wailing and clawing at them until they are driven to horrified distraction.

enhancements.name: Predestined Champion
enhancements.text: While the bearer is on the battlefield, you are considered to control one additional objective marker for the purposes of the Twisting Fate army rule.

enhancements.name: Astral Predation
enhancements.text: Once per battle, in your Movement phase, when the bearer is selected to move, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one closed Hatchway on the battlefield. Until the end of the phase, the bearer can move through that Hatchway as if it was open (note that this does not open that Hatchway - it remains closed).

psychicdominion.name: PSYCHIC DOMINION
psychicdominion.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
psychicdominion.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
psychicdominion.effect: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [hazardous] ability, and models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks.
psychicdominion.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [hazardous] ability, and models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks.
psychicdominion.flavour: To pit one's psychic prowess against the sorcerous might of the Thousand Sons is to be trapped, helpless and screaming, within one's mind.

destinedbyfate.name: DESTINED BY FATE
destinedbyfate.when: Any phase, just after a saving throw is failed for a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple saving throws at once.
destinedbyfate.effect: Change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those attacks you failed a saving throw for.
destinedbyfate.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after a saving throw is failed for a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple saving throws at once.

TARGET: That PSYKER model.

EFFECT: Change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those attacks you failed a saving throw for.
destinedbyfate.flavour: The Architect of Fate has great designs for his pawns, which do not yet include their untimely demise.

egotisticalpower.name: EGOTISTICAL POWER
egotisticalpower.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army.
egotisticalpower.effect: Select the Imbued Manifestation, Psychic Maelstrom or Wrath of the Immaterium ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability applies to your unit instead of any other Kindred Sorcery ability, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.
egotisticalpower.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select the Imbued Manifestation, Psychic Maelstrom or Wrath of the Immaterium ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability applies to your unit instead of any other Kindred Sorcery ability, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.
egotisticalpower.flavour: Drawing on the accumulating empyric energies, one devoted to Tzeentch will willingly syphon the swelling power to fuel their selfish ploys.

desecrationofworlds.name: DESECRATION OF WORLDS
desecrationofworlds.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
desecrationofworlds.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
desecrationofworlds.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.

EFFECT: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
desecrationofworlds.flavour: The Sorcerers of the Thousand Sons pour their corrupting spite and contempt into the bedrock of the battlefield, tainting it with their warpcraft.

arcanefocus.name: ARCANE FOCUS
arcanefocus.when: Your Shooting phase, just after you take a Psychic test for a THOUSAND SONS model from your army that Channelled the Warp (before resolving that Ritual).
arcanefocus.effect: Re-roll all of the D6 rolled for that Psychic test (including the additional D6 for Channelling the Warp).
arcanefocus.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after you take a Psychic test for a THOUSAND SONS model from your army that Channelled the Warp (before resolving that Ritual).

TARGET: That THOUSAND SONS model.

EFFECT: Re-roll all of the D6 rolled for that Psychic test (including the additional D6 for Channelling the Warp).
arcanefocus.flavour: Using a locus formed from the ritually broken matter of sorcerous artefacts, a Sorcerer can infuse themselves with its power. So invigorated, their empyrically fuelled manipulations are made all the more potent.

devastatingsorcery.name: DEVASTATING SORCERY
devastatingsorcery.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
devastatingsorcery.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 9" to the Range characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit, and each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Psychic weapon, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
devastatingsorcery.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 9" to the Range characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit, and each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Psychic weapon, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
devastatingsorcery.flavour: The Thousand Sons' flesh seethes with raw sorcery. The sheer unstoppable might of their conjurations is such that little can prevent them from manifesting devastation when unleashed with destructive intent.

sulphurousveil.name: SULPHUROUS VEIL
sulphurousveil.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
sulphurousveil.target: One THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
sulphurousveil.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
sulphurousveil.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
sulphurousveil.flavour: Gouts of choking brimstone or arcane smog seeping from the Warp are exploited to confound the foe.

deceptiveglamour.name: DECEPTIVE GLAMOUR
deceptiveglamour.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army.
deceptiveglamour.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets for its attacks, it can only target your unit if there are no eligible SCINTILLATING LEGIONS targets for those attacks.
deceptiveglamour.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets for its attacks, it can only target your unit if there are no eligible SCINTILLATING LEGIONS targets for those attacks.
deceptiveglamour.flavour: Tendrils of phantasmal sorcery are sent to invade the minds of the Thousand Sons' foes, magnifying the infernal threat until it eclipses all others in a kaleidoscope of insanity.

etherealphantasm.name: ETHEREAL PHANTASM
etherealphantasm.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
etherealphantasm.target: One SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
etherealphantasm.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or a Normal move of up to 6" instead if it is wholly within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS units.
etherealphantasm.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or a Normal move of up to 6" instead if it is wholly within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS units.
etherealphantasm.flavour: Semi-sentient doppelgangers stalk the battlefield, bewildering attempts to target the daemonic spawn.

fractaldisjunction.name: FRACTAL DISJUNCTION
fractaldisjunction.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
fractaldisjunction.target: One SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTERS) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
fractaldisjunction.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
fractaldisjunction.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTERS) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
fractaldisjunction.flavour: Tzeentchian daemons can twist perceptions until they seem no longer there, bending light and dissipating technological targeting scans in a dizzying, fractal puzzle.

chronosorcerousbleed.name: CHRONOSORCEROUS BLEED
chronosorcerousbleed.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
chronosorcerousbleed.target: One friendly unengaged THOUSAND SONS PSYKER/SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit.
chronosorcerousbleed.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
chronosorcerousbleed.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged THOUSAND SONS PSYKER/SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
chronosorcerousbleed.flavour: By sacrificing minute slivers of the oncoming foes' lives, time can be bled into the Warp, stretching perceptions and causing sudden exhaustion.

glimmershiftportal.name: GLIMMERSHIFT PORTAL
glimmershiftportal.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
glimmershiftportal.target: Up to two SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units from your army (excluding MONSTERS), or one SCINTILLATING LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army, if all of those units are more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
glimmershiftportal.effect: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
glimmershiftportal.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: Up to two SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units from your army (excluding MONSTERS), or one SCINTILLATING LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army, if all of those units are more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
glimmershiftportal.flavour: Weaving a spell of splintering translocation, Tzeentch's daemons can prise open an unnatural pathway through the Warp.

giftofchange.name: GIFT OF CHANGE
giftofchange.target: One THOUSAND SONS CHARACTER model from your army (excluding MONSTERS) that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
giftofchange.effect: At the end of the phase, add one TZEENTCH CHAOS SPAWN unit containing one model to your army, and set it up as close as possible to where your model was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
giftofchange.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
giftofchange.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS CHARACTER model from your army (excluding MONSTERS) that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: At the end of the phase, add one TZEENTCH CHAOS SPAWN unit containing one model to your army, and set it up as close as possible to where your model was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
giftofchange.flavour: For those already saturated by the coursing power of the Warp, even death is no barrier to change.

warpedvicissitude.name: WARPED VICISSITUDE
warpedvicissitude.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
warpedvicissitude.target: One TZAANGORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
warpedvicissitude.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
warpedvicissitude.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TZAANGORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
warpedvicissitude.flavour: With a shrieked plea to Tzeentch, mutant flesh can flicker between insubstantial states as if not there.

derangedferocity.name: DERANGED FEROCITY
derangedferocity.when: Fight phase, just after a TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army is selected to fight.
derangedferocity.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", and when determining which models in it are eligible to fight, any models in it that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.
derangedferocity.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army is selected to fight.

TARGET: That TZEENTCH MUTANT unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", and when determining which models in it are eligible to fight, any models in it that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.
derangedferocity.flavour: With insane, bestial ferocity is true change wrought.

blessedtransmutations.name: BLESSED TRANSMUTATIONS
blessedtransmutations.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army, and one friendly TZAANGORS unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 12" of that PSYKER model.
blessedtransmutations.effect: Return up to D3+1 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTERS) to your TZAANGORS unit.
blessedtransmutations.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army, and one friendly TZAANGORS unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 12" of that PSYKER model.

EFFECT: Return up to D3+1 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTERS) to your TZAANGORS unit.
blessedtransmutations.flavour: When Tzeentchian magicks wax strong, spirit and flesh are yoked again and again in service to the Great Sorcerer.

touchedbytzeentch.name: TOUCHED BY TZEENTCH
touchedbytzeentch.target: One TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army.
touchedbytzeentch.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
touchedbytzeentch.text:
WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
touchedbytzeentch.flavour: The mutagenic vitality flowing through the Thousand Sons' twisted thralls can manifest in flickering bursts of supernatural speed.

twistedmirage.name: TWISTED MIRAGE
twistedmirage.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
twistedmirage.target: One TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army that is arriving from Strategic Reserves this phase.
twistedmirage.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, or anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units if it is a MONSTER unit. In either case, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.
twistedmirage.text:
WHEN: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army that is arriving from Strategic Reserves this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, or anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units if it is a MONSTER unit. In either case, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.
twistedmirage.flavour: The very flesh of a Warpmeld Pact's mutant abominations radiates a reality-twisting aura. They may appear in one place to their foes, but things are not always as they seem.

ardentautomata.name: ARDENT AUTOMATA
ardentautomata.when: Your Movement phase, just after a RUBRICAE unit from your army Falls Back.
ardentautomata.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
ardentautomata.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a RUBRICAE unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That RUBRICAE unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
ardentautomata.flavour: The martial discipline once known amongst the Legion's fellowships has been pared back and twisted until it is another means of control, one which the Rubricae’s masters use to wrongfoot their foes with sudden changes of tactics.

inexorableadvance.name: INEXORABLE ADVANCE
inexorableadvance.target: One RUBRICAE unit from your army.
inexorableadvance.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance rolls made for it, and ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
inexorableadvance.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One RUBRICAE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance rolls made for it, and ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
inexorableadvance.flavour: The warriors of the Thousand Sons can be driven on relentlessly while laying down a hail of weapons fire. They know no fatigue nor weakness, unable to falter even if they wished to.

infernalfusillade.name: INFERNAL FUSILLADE
infernalfusillade.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
infernalfusillade.effect: Until the end of the phase, all inferno bolt pistols, inferno boltguns, inferno combi-bolters and inferno combi-weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability.
infernalfusillade.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, all inferno bolt pistols, inferno boltguns, inferno combi-bolters and inferno combi-weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability.
infernalfusillade.flavour: Arcane invocations imbue the Thousand Sons’ weapons with sorcerous power, rendering them still more lethal to the foe.

revengeoftherubricae.name: REVENGE OF THE RUBRICAE
revengeoftherubricae.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army is destroyed.
revengeoftherubricae.target: One RUBRICAE unit from your army that was within 6" of that PSYKER model when it was destroyed.
revengeoftherubricae.effect: After the attacking unit has shot, your RUBRICAE unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target the enemy unit that just destroyed your PSYKER model (and only if it is an eligible target).
revengeoftherubricae.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army is destroyed.

TARGET: One RUBRICAE unit from your army that was within 6" of that PSYKER model when it was destroyed.

EFFECT: After the attacking unit has shot, your RUBRICAE unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target the enemy unit that just destroyed your PSYKER model (and only if it is an eligible target).
revengeoftherubricae.flavour: Magnus’ psychic scions are as vindictive as their Daemon Primarch. Many weave arcane curses and runes of spite into the eldritch armour of their guardians. Should they fall, their Rubricae unleash a vengeful doom upon the executioners.

implacableguardians.name: IMPLACABLE GUARDIANS
implacableguardians.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
implacableguardians.target: One RUBRIC MARINES PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
implacableguardians.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit (excluding PSYKER models), subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
implacableguardians.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One RUBRIC MARINES PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit (excluding PSYKER models), subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
implacableguardians.flavour: The Rubricae are superlative, enduring guardians who can absorb great storms of fire if it means shielding their masters.

unwaveringphalanx.name: UNWAVERING PHALANX
unwaveringphalanx.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
unwaveringphalanx.target: One RUBRIC MARINES unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
unwaveringphalanx.effect: Until the end of the turn, attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
unwaveringphalanx.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.

TARGET: One RUBRIC MARINES unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
unwaveringphalanx.flavour: Massed in an unyielding wall of sorcerous ceramite, the sheer unnatural resilience of the Thousand Sons can withstand the most vicious assault.

hexmarkedarmour.name: HEX-MARKED ARMOUR
hexmarkedarmour.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
hexmarkedarmour.target: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
hexmarkedarmour.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
hexmarkedarmour.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
hexmarkedarmour.flavour: Amorphous runes and sigils carved into the armoured flanks of the Cabal's war engines flare with unholy power, leaching the foe's attacks of strength.

mutatelandscape.name: MUTATE LANDSCAPE
mutatelandscape.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
mutatelandscape.effect: That objective marker is mutated, and remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. While an objective marker is mutated and under your control, each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range of that objective marker, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
mutatelandscape.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.

EFFECT: That objective marker is mutated, and remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. While an objective marker is mutated and under your control, each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range of that objective marker, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
mutatelandscape.flavour: Where the Warpforged Cabals spread their malignant change, the terrain erupts in uncontrolled mutation or transmogrifies into hazardous forms.

cyberspiritmachinations.name: CYBERSPIRIT MACHINATIONS
cyberspiritmachinations.when: Your Movement phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army Falls Back.
cyberspiritmachinations.target: That VEHICLE unit, and one friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit within 6" of that VEHICLE unit.
cyberspiritmachinations.effect: Until the end of the turn, your VEHICLE unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
cyberspiritmachinations.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That VEHICLE unit, and one friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit within 6" of that VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your VEHICLE unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
cyberspiritmachinations.flavour: Technoshamanic rites can briefly possess a vehicle's logic-cores, shackling its mechanisms to a new lore.

malevolentanimus.name: MALEVOLENT ANIMUS
malevolentanimus.target: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units.
malevolentanimus.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your VEHICLE unit is malevolent. While a unit is malevolent, it can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: the profile characteristics of its models; the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by its models; any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).
malevolentanimus.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your VEHICLE unit is malevolent. While a unit is malevolent, it can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: the profile characteristics of its models; the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by its models; any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).
malevolentanimus.flavour: Whether a corrupted machine spirit or a cackling possessor daemon, the core animus of many Thousand Sons war engines seethe with a malignity that sees them unerringly strike out at prey even when critical systems are compromised.

ensorcelledinfusion.name: ENSORCELLED INFUSION
ensorcelledinfusion.target: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase, that is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units.
ensorcelledinfusion.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by VEHICLE models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability and each time an attack is made with such a weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll.
ensorcelledinfusion.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase, that is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by VEHICLE models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability and each time an attack is made with such a weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll.
ensorcelledinfusion.flavour: Utilising the fell powers of the Warp, Thousand Sons Sorcerers infuse vehicles with empyric energies to render them even deadlier.

warpflamegargoyles.name: WARPFLAME GARGOYLES
warpflamegargoyles.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
warpflamegargoyles.target: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
warpflamegargoyles.effect: Roll six D6: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. That enemy unit must then take a Battle-shock test.
warpflamegargoyles.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Roll six D6: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. That enemy unit must then take a Battle-shock test.
warpflamegargoyles.flavour: On the hulls of vehicles swollen with the power of Tzeentch, gnashing maws open to spew warpfire over those nearby.

relentlessrebirth.name: RELENTLESS REBIRTH
relentlessrebirth.when: Any phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit suffers a mortal wound.
relentlessrebirth.target: That INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.
relentlessrebirth.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
relentlessrebirth.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
relentlessrebirth.flavour: As quickly as these warriors are wounded, so their corporeal forms regenerate with supernatural swiftness.

mutagenicmagicks.name: MUTAGENIC MAGICKS
mutagenicmagicks.target: One friendly engaged THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.
mutagenicmagicks.effect: Start of the Fight phase. One friendly engaged Thousand Sons Psyker unit. Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll six D6: For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
mutagenicmagicks.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly engaged THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.

EFFECT: Start of the Fight phase. One friendly engaged Thousand Sons Psyker unit. Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll six D6: For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
mutagenicmagicks.flavour: Focusing the unholy energies of their ritual into the bodies of the foe, the champions of Tzeentch cause them to erupt into a riot of gruesome and unstoppable mutation.

multitudinouslimbs.name: MULTITUDINOUS LIMBS
multitudinouslimbs.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit is selected to make an advance/fall back move.
multitudinouslimbs.target: That INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.
multitudinouslimbs.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
multitudinouslimbs.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit is selected to make an advance/fall back move.

TARGET: That INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
multitudinouslimbs.flavour: So unstoppable is the torrent of life rushing through these warriors that their bodies and even their wargear sprout nests of twitching limbs that move and act with a mind of their own.

arcaneventing.name: ARCANE VENTING
arcaneventing.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
arcaneventing.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
arcaneventing.flavour: Even as they cross the battlefield, so these Sekhetar Robots vent glittering sorcerous residue that contaminates sites of power and importance.

ectoplasmicextrusion.name: ECTOPLASMIC EXTRUSION
ectoplasmicextrusion.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 12" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit starts an action.
ectoplasmicextrusion.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
ectoplasmicextrusion.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 12" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit starts an action.

TARGET: That SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit.

EFFECT: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
ectoplasmicextrusion.flavour: Employing a form of limited astral projection, the Sorcerer possesses these robots and then extrudes ectoplasmic limbs from within their bodies to work his will even as they continue to fight.

warpfields.name: WARP FIELDS
warpfields.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 12" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.
warpfields.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
warpfields.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 12" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.

TARGET: That SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
warpfields.flavour: Weaving sorcery into a shimmering shield, the sorcerer protects his enslaved automata from harm.

prismaticdisplacement.name: PRISMATIC DISPLACEMENT
prismaticdisplacement.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED MUTANT unit is selected to make an advance/fall back move.
prismaticdisplacement.effect:
- Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn.

- That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.
prismaticdisplacement.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED MUTANT unit is selected to make an advance/fall back move.

TARGET: That INFANTRY/MOUNTED MUTANT unit.

EFFECT:

- Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn.

- That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.
prismaticdisplacement.flavour: Flickering light like cast through a many-faceted gem, the skyborne warriors of Tzeentch seem to manifest and fade, then leap back into sharp relief elsewhere with sudden violence.

temporalinstability.name: TEMPORAL INSTABILITY
temporalinstability.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED MUTANT unit is selected to make an advance/fall back move.
temporalinstability.effect: In a turn your unit made an advance/fall-back move, that move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
temporalinstability.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED MUTANT unit is selected to make an advance/fall back move.

TARGET: That INFANTRY/MOUNTED MUTANT unit.

EFFECT: In a turn your unit made an advance/fall-back move, that move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
temporalinstability.flavour: Time runs differently around these warriors, allowing them ample space to act while their foes appear to lurch sluggishly on around them.

thelandwrithes.name: THE LAND WRITHES
thelandwrithes.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly MONSTER MUTANT unit is selected to move.
thelandwrithes.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly MONSTER MUTANT unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That MONSTER MUTANT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.
thelandwrithes.flavour: The very fabric of reality runs like melting wax before this monstrous abomination, oozing aside to clear its path.

wardinghex.name: WARDING HEX
wardinghex.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control, if that objective marker is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic.
wardinghex.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
wardinghex.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control, if that objective marker is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic.

EFFECT: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
wardinghex.flavour: Thousand Sons Sorcerers draw upon tide swells of Warp energy to weave spells of binding and warding, thereby shackling sites of arcane power to their own arrogant will.

wrathofthedoomed.name: WRATH OF THE DOOMED
wrathofthedoomed.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
wrathofthedoomed.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
wrathofthedoomed.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
wrathofthedoomed.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
wrathofthedoomed.flavour: Forewarned of the moment of their demise, the followers of Tzeentch allow the flood of magic to run rampant through their forms, providing them with a final burst of killing energy before unbound arcane force rips their bodies asunder

strandsoftime.name: STRANDS OF TIME
strandsoftime.when: Your Movement phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army Falls Back.
strandsoftime.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic when it is targeted with this Stratagem, then until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
strandsoftime.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic when it is targeted with this Stratagem, then until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
strandsoftime.flavour: By drawing upon their expanding nexus of magic, this disciple of Tzeentch can tear strands of temporal energy from the Warp and wind them around themselves and their thralls. Lent speed by this garland of stolen time, they melt away from their foes’ desperate strikes before lashing out again.

throughtheveil.name: THROUGH THE VEIL
throughtheveil.when: Start of the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
throughtheveil.target: One RUBRIC MARINES or SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves.
throughtheveil.effect: If it is a RUBRIC MARINES unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Deep Strike ability. When your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is a SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATOR unit it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.
throughtheveil.restrictions: If a SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS unit is targeted with this Stratagem, it is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
throughtheveil.text:
WHEN: Start of the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One RUBRIC MARINES or SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves.

EFFECT: If it is a RUBRIC MARINES unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Deep Strike ability. empyricdesecration.flavour: Powerful Sorcerers may use their mastery of the warp to corrupt areas of the battlefield and deny them to the foe.

infernobolters.effect: Select one closed Hatchway. Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can make attacks with ranged weapons (excluding Torrent weapons) that target enemy units within 1" of that Hatchway and that are wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, as if that Hatchway was open. tzeentchsboon.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army within range of an objective marker that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

tzeentchsboon.flavour: This psyker’s devotion to the God of Change has been rewarded with terrible destructive power.

psychicingress.flavour: The Sorcerers of the Thousand Sons can draw upon their powers to melt away hatches and bulkheads.

fellsacrifice.flavour: As ritual violence gathers in intensity, the massed thralls of the Thousand Sons swell with the terrifying powers of the warp.

bestialsurge.target: One TZAANGORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

bestialsurge.flavour: When struck by enemy fire, the bestial Tzaangors react with instinctive fury, surging towards their assailants in a vengeful flock.

enduringanimus.flavour: The malefic spirit echoes bound within the armour of the Thousand Sons cling tenaciously to existence and are not banished easily.
